title: Beyond Midnight
identity_notes: South African horror/supernatural anthology produced by Michael McCabe as the successor to SF68. The 57-object frozen GRH container mixes dated collector entries, undated alias/copy titles, genuinely undated survivors, and one item (Cassius Touch) that specialist research says is not a Beyond Midnight episode.

eras.label: Springbok Radio run
eras.notes: Friday-night horror/supernatural anthology; public logs disagree on exact episode count and some collector dates.

historical_context.title: Biotex-sponsored commercial radio
historical_context.description: Biotex sponsorship linked the anthology to Springbok Radio’s commercial broadcasting model.

historical_context.title: International horror literature adapted for South African radio
historical_context.description: The series drew on British, American and other English-language supernatural and horror fiction from the nineteenth and twentieth centuries.

historical_context.title: South African commercial radio anthology
historical_context.description: Beyond Midnight was produced for Springbok Radio, South Africa’s commercial radio service, as a weekly late-evening anthology.

historical_context.title: Transition from science fiction to supernatural horror
historical_context.description: The program replaced Michael McCabe’s SF68 and shifted the anthology emphasis toward supernatural, ghost and horror material.
